obfuscation_indicators: could cause actual results to differ materially
risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively informative on sales, margins, profitability, market conditions, and tax assets, but is heavily supplemented by broad forward-looking disclaimers and an extensive generic risk list. Credit risk is elevated by the sharp gross-margin decline, fiscal-year net loss, supply-chain and cost pressures, leverage and covenant constraints, and sensitivity to housing and interest rates, although sales growth and liquidity-related disclosures provide some offset.
